column7: Resolves a held stream credential to the caller it authenticates as right now and judges the identity it was admitted under (CF assertion, adapter window); a credential that no longer authenticates, or an identity that expired, is Dead and the stream closes or is refused (MIK-8350)
The answer to a caller that no longer resolves when its stream opens: the auth layer's invalid-credential 401, with no reason in the body (MIK-8350)
Admits a subscriptions/listen stream: refuses a credential that does not authenticate, takes a permit, then refuses a caller that no longer resolves at attach as an invalid credential (MIK-8350)

Refuses stdio startup before initialization when capability account admission reports a rejected descriptor and propagates account strategy installation failure; this helper owns the startup rejection rather than merely wiring it (MIK-8350)
Refuses an unreadable clock, out-of-range skew or signed issuance beyond current time plus skew; shared by admission and held adapter liveness (MIK-8350)
Installs each admitted attachment's weak subject and close receiver without extending plaintext custody; builds the existing lifetime check (MIK-8350)
Decides whether default cold-session identity fallback is permitted; a previously opened closed session must not be rejudged as cold (MIK-8350)
Builds one stream attachment's close lease shared by its clones; a missing lease would disable stream-close custody (MIK-8350)
Builds initially-open retained closure signaling used to cancel held-subject work; performs no authentication exchange (MIK-8350)
Publishes retained closure when the final stream-view lease drops, causing fanout refusal and cancellation of upgraded raw-subject work (MIK-8350)
Installs a receipt-specific weak subject and retained close receiver, building custody enforcement without owning plaintext or the stream lease (MIK-8350)
Decides whether a registration is closed or its subject is gone and can be removed from active fanout (MIK-8350)
Owns the retained-close predicate that refuses work after stream closure before and after resolution or cache reading (MIK-8350)
Returns on retained closure or sender loss so biased selection cancels the whole resolve/read/digest operation and drops upgraded raw subjects (MIK-8350)
Refuses the held stream identity as Dead(Adapter) when its adapter assertion's window is no longer live (MIK-8350)
Decides held assertion liveness from signed expiry and issued-at with the admission skew, including fail-closed clock and rollback handling (MIK-8350)
Gates judged fanout with closed-versus-cold history, current identity resolution and whole-operation close cancellation while preserving the anonymous bearer carveout (MIK-8350)
Builds the durable secret-free record and preserves opened-session history across idle pruning so the existing cold-fallback check remains installed (MIK-8350)
Builds receipt-specific weak fanout targets after the separately inventoried dead-registration check; does not authenticate or extend raw-secret custody (MIK-8350)
Reverifies the held CF assertion and refuses expired identity, absent verifier, failed verification or exhausted transient grace (MIK-8350)
Classifies actual verifier outcomes as Good, Transient or Dead, selecting authentication refusal or bounded transient grace (MIK-8350)
Decides held CF signed-expiry liveness using the same leeway as verification before current-key verification and transient grace (MIK-8350)
Owns actual adapter signature, issuer, expiry, lifetime, future-issuance and identity admission refusal; uses the same signed issued-at check as held liveness (MIK-8350)
Resolves the held caller and identity at hint write, returns Dead for refusal while preserving anonymous bearer silence, and decides whether the current scoped digest is owed (MIK-8350)
Refuses a stale-caller hint when its captured epoch differs from the current record and delegates the existing stamped commit decision before permitting the write (MIK-8350)
Owns GET hint write eligibility: closes a dead caller, writes only an owed view accepted by commit, and otherwise skips (MIK-8350)
Owns Quiet versus Owed eligibility for a scoped view hint, including the unbaselined and unchanged-view veto, and is consumed by Critical write and fanout decisions (MIK-8350)

Independently vetoes an unbaselined or stale-stamp hint and decides whether its scoped digest is owed; its returned permission controls the actual write through StreamView::commit and decide (MIK-8350)

Decides whether a GET stream may open before any session effect: refuses a caller whose held credential no longer resolves, admits one that presented nothing on a public path anonymously, else admits the resolved caller (MIK-8350)

Decides whether a session-stream frame that is not a judged hint may be written: closes the stream when the held subject no longer resolves (expired adapter receipt, failed CF re-verify), with the anonymous public-path carve-out (MIK-8350)
